name: top-down rise
description: Camera rises straight upward while looking vertically down, widening the view.

prompt.default: Camera rises straight upward while looking vertically down, widening the view.
prompt.kling: Camera rises straight upward while looking vertically down, widening the view.
prompt.seedance: Camera rises straight upward while looking vertically down, widening the view throughout one continuous shot.
prompt.veo: Camera rises straight upward while looking vertically down, widening the view.
prompt.wan: Camera rises straight upward while looking vertically down, widening the view.
prompt.local-wan: The camera looks straight down and rises vertically above the subject. The subject becomes smaller as the ground fills an increasingly wide overhead view. One continuous shot.
